name: Tropeognathus (Ocean)
label: Ocean variant
title: Sturmsegler
note: The big-winged ocean wanderer of the profile ("coastal regions and open seas"), kept to the open sea: Kelp Vale, the Abyssal Depths and the Stonebed Shoal, resting on the water like an albatross, with the sea cliffs of the Coastal Bluffs as its launch point. Shares the official Tropeognathus profile with the coast variant.
